summary: List available External Submittal Filter Options
description: Returns a list of available External Submittals Filter Options for the specified Project

key.description: Machine-readable identifier of the filter. Use this value as the path segment when requesting the filter's available options (for example, request the `submittal_manager_contact_id` options endpoint).

value.description: Localized, human-readable label for the filter, suitable for display in a filter menu.

endpoint.description: Relative URL of the endpoint that returns the selectable options for this filter. Call it to populate the filter's choices.
